{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Ensure sample_seq is numeric and deduplicate by keeping highest sample_seq per patient
df['sample_seq'] = pd.to_numeric(df['sample_seq'], errors='coerce')

df = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Confirm no missing values in biomarker_baseline
assert df['biomarker_baseline'].isnull().sum() == 0, "Missing values found in biomarker_baseline"

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value
mean_biomarker = df['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Return the result
mean_biomarker"}
